slots.hair: a shoulder-length inward-curled bob with a wispy fringe
slots.outfit: an apron kept on with its ties tied at the front, and underneath it a loose cream knit slipped below the shoulder
slots.place: sitting on the floor of her very small apartment against the low table, everything she owns on the floor around her
slots.action: She is sitting against the low table with the apron still on but changed underneath it, the ties knotted at the front.
slots.face: Completely expressionless, looking at the lens.
slots.light: The window light comes from in front of her, the inner side of the flat is dark, and nothing is over-sharpened.

slots.hair: a shoulder-length bob tucked behind one ear
slots.outfit: a beige-grey cotton fine-strap top and shorts
slots.place: on the floor of her apartment with the convenience-store pudding she always buys on the low table
slots.action: She is sitting cross-legged about to dig into the pudding with a spoon in one hand.
slots.face: Looking at the pudding rather than the lens, her expression not changing at all.
slots.light: A small lamp beside the low table is in front of her and low, and the rest of the flat is dark.

slots.hair: a shoulder-length bob, damp, being tucked behind one ear
slots.outfit: a cream towel wrapped around her
slots.place: in the very small bathroom of her apartment straight out of the shower
slots.action: Her free hand is tucking the damp shoulder-length hair behind her ear.
slots.face: Just woken with a very empty look.
slots.light: The light above the mirror is directly in front of her and the depth of the bathroom is dark.

slots.hair: a shoulder-length bob with the wispy fringe, tidy
slots.outfit: a dark coffee-brown apron with its ties knotted at the front over a wood-brown short-sleeved top
slots.place: in the Nakameguro coffee shop before opening, the shop lights not on yet and only the window light in
slots.action: She is wiping the counter down with a cloth in one hand, the steam wand not switched on yet.
slots.face: Her attention is on the counter and not the lens, with no expression at all.
slots.light: The window light comes in from in front of her onto the counter and her face, the depth of the shop is still dark, and dust hangs in the air.

slots.hair: a shoulder-length bob with the fringe brushed straight
slots.outfit: a window-light-yellow fine knit cardigan over a cream fitted vest
slots.place: inside a convenience store in Nakameguro on her way home, standing at the chilled dessert cabinet
slots.action: She is standing at the chilled cabinet lifting out the same pudding she always buys.
slots.face: Looking at the pudding in the cabinet with no expression.
slots.light: The light inside the chilled cabinet throws forward onto her face and the rest of the shop is not as bright as she is.
